teams.detail: Eliminated in East Semis, Game 7 blowout vs. CLE. Jalen Duren ($41M/yr max) free agent decision headlines the offseason.
Game 3 vs. Athletics at Sutter Health Park today (3:05 PM PT, result pending). Won 4-1 on Tue. Record ~27-29. Series Game 4 Thu May 28.
Defending champions. OTAs underway; signed S Bud Clark, 7/8 draft picks under contract. Mourning former captain Charle Young. Open Sept 9 vs. NE.
Official visits begin June 5, incl. 4-star S Jayden Walk-Green. Landed in-state 4-star DL May 23. Season opener Sept 5 vs. WSU.
Transfers added from Texas Tech and San Francisco for 2026-27. Dawg Pack season tickets on sale. Season tips Nov 1, 2026.

headlines.headline: SPURS SURVIVE ELIMINATION GAME 5, FORCE GAME 6; KNICKS AWAIT IN FINALS
headlines.detail: San Antonio won Game 5 to trail OKC 3-2; Game 6 Thu May 28. Knicks swept Cavaliers 4-0 to reach first Finals since 1999. Finals tip June 3 on ABC.

headlines.headline: DERWIN JAMES SIGNS $75.6M EXTENSION AS OTA INJURIES HIT THE GIANTS
headlines.detail: Chargers safety James becomes highest-paid at his position. Giants lose DL Roy Robertson-Harris for the season to torn Achilles in OTAs.

headlines.headline: LSU CLAIMS TOP PORTAL CLASS WITH LEAVITT, SEATON, UMANMIELEN AMONG 8 TOP-100 ADDS
headlines.detail: Lane Kiffin's LSU leads all portal rankings. Washington begins official visits June 5, targeting 4-star S Jayden Walk-Green.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA TOPS WAY-TOO-EARLY 2026-27 POLLS AS NBA EARLY-ENTRY DEADLINE CLOSES TODAY
headlines.detail: Gators retain championship frontcourt. NBA early-entry withdrawal deadline today (May 27) finalizes college rosters for 2026-27.
